title: Bus-Occluded Child at a Signalized Crossing
intent: Discount a legal green because the stopped bus creates a severe sight-line hazard, stop for the unexpected child, absorb rear pressure, and remain stopped until the whole crossing clears.
requiredOutcomes: approach speed at or below 20 km/h before bus front
ego does not enter occupied crosswalk
peak deceleration at or below 6 m/s2
ego remains stopped through child hesitation and continuation
